prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in League City, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1213; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just be identified as the driver of the vehicle, if that's alright.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was on a two-lane road in League City, Texas, near a shopping center entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I was heading toward the entrance and slowing down. Another vehicle was coming from the opposite direction and turning across my lane.
Q: How fast would you estimate you were traveling?
A: Not fast at all. I'd guess maybe fifteen or twenty miles per hour. It was more of a tap than a crash.
Q: Did either airbag deploy?
A: No, nothing deployed. Both cars rolled a little and stopped.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle after the collision?
A: Yes, I walked around for a minute, then sat back down because my lower back felt tight.
Q: Are you experiencing any pain now?
A: Yes, a dull ache in my lower back, mostly when I bend or sit for a long time. I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They said it looked like a back strain and gave me some exercises.
Q: Did you have any back problems before this collision?
A: Nothing serious. I had a stiff back now and then from sitting at a desk, but I hadn't seen a doctor for it.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Just that I want to cooperate fully and I'll send along any paperwork from the clinic.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
